counts_note: 2026-11-12 (OPEN_ISSUES.md B2): GDOT's report counts Peachtree through traffic (NB_T, SB_T) with stop-bar presence zones and reads 2.5-4.3x below the upstream count zones every day. NB_T and SB_T are taken from the upstream zones (Approach Volume minus the report's left + through, 15-min totals split evenly over the 5-min bins; tools/lanecheck/build_upstream_counts.py). Every other column is the report as exported. SB_T is confirmed by signal 7058 hour by hour; NB_T is an upper estimate (signal 7066 sends 60-80 % of it). Left turns use the same zone type and are probably undercounted; kept as reported. ATSC_COUNTS=report in the environment selects the report as exported.

notes.phases: first = protected phase; Piedmont lefts (EB_L, WB_L) also run permissive in the opposing through phase (flashing yellow arrow)
notes.rights: right turns are not counted by GDOT at 7065 (no count detector on the right lanes) and carry no demand
notes.entry_edges: where vehicles enter: the first edge of each leg of the aerial twin (network/build_ext.py): N 258, S 170, SW 89, NE 142 m upstream of the stop line. SW ends just short of signal 7066 (92 m); N reaches ~40 m beyond 7071 (219 m), NE and S stop short of 7058 (190 m) and the OSM network edge (291 m). The 7065v2 (OSM) entries of 2026-10-30 are in git history.
